description: Shahkaar introduces itself as a Kashmir based neo-craft cum fashion brand, aiming to preserve and promote the rich Kashmir crafts far and wide. We envision to empower the Kashmir’s exceptional artisan community and simultaneously endeavour to generate respectable employment for the unemployed youth. We design, manufacture, and promote Handcrafted Luxury Pure Pashmina Shawls, Scarves & Wraps.
